metadata.title: Aarogya Sathi — 42-Query Adversarial Router Test Dataset
metadata.description: Test queries for evaluating the safety router's ability to intercept adversarial queries and pass legitimate health queries. These are DISTINCT from the 42 training utterances in routes.py — they are test queries only.
